description.name: Ilya
description.body: small, 3 heads tall, sturdy build, confident stance, facing the viewer
details: empty hands and no weapon, shield or pack
leather belt with a small pouch

prompt:
Hand-painted 2D game art in the style of a 1999 storybook RPG.
Soft watercolour and gouache shading with visible brush texture and 3 to 5 value steps per colour.
Warm golden key light from the upper left, blue-violet shadows.
Selective coloured outlines, rounded organic shapes, whimsical fairy-tale mood. Softened saturation.
No writing anywhere: labels, signs and covers are blank or carry simple symbols.
A single game sprite in three-quarter top-down view, centred, with empty margin all around it.
Background: one flat solid pure magenta (#FF00FF) filling everything behind the subject,
with no floor, scenery, gradient, glow, vignette or shadow on it. No magenta anywhere in the subject.
Paint the character in the reference picture again, exactly the same: face, hair, clothes, colours, proportions, pose, size and framing.
Change only this: a neutral base pose for walk animation: standing straight and still, facing the viewer directly from the front (not turned to either side), body and face symmetric, eye-level front view with no tilt, feet a little apart under the hips, both arms relaxed and hanging at the sides, empty hands; the red scarf hangs down at rest instead of flying out to the side.
